# Sentron Global Logistics (SGL)

> Reliability That Moves The World — Premier Multimodal International Freight Forwarder, Licensed Customs Brokerage (CHA), IATA Registered, and AEO-T2 Accredited Operator.

Sentron Global Logistics (SGL) orchestrates end-to-end multimodal supply chains across 65+ countries. We connect ocean carriers, air cargo fleets, port drayage, and customs authorities under dedicated human logistics desks backed by guaranteed 18-minute quotation turnarounds.

## Primary Services
- [Ocean Freight (FCL / LCL)](https://sentronglobal.com/services/ocean): Full Container Load and Less-than-Container Load maritime transport across 100+ global corridors. Tier-1 shipping line space allocations, dangerous goods (IMO/DG), and direct bill of lading issuance.
- [Air Cargo Express & Priority](https://sentronglobal.com/services/air): Time-critical international aviation, temperature-monitored pharmaceutical cold chain (+2°C to +8°C / -20°C), AOG spares, and next-flight-out prioritization.
- [Intermodal Road & Port Drayage](https://sentronglobal.com/services/road): GPS-tracked container haulage, port terminal drayage, pan-India distribution, and over-dimensional project cargo.
- [Smart Warehousing & 3PL](https://sentronglobal.com/services/warehousing): Strategically situated bonded and dry storage hubs near sea/air ports, real-time inventory management, palletization, kitting, and cross-docking.
- [Licensed Customs Brokerage (CHA)](https://sentronglobal.com/services): In-house Custom House Agent filing achieving 96% pre-arrival clearance, tariff HS code classification, and zero demurrage demurrage defense.

## Global Hubs & Gateway Corridors
- **India Port Hubs**: Port of Chennai (MAA), Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mundra, Kolkata, Cochin, Tuticorin.
- **Middle East**: Dubai / Jebel Ali (DXB/JEA), Abu Dhabi, Dammam.
- **Southeast Asia**: Singapore Hub (SIN), Port Klang, Bangkok, Ho Chi Minh.
- **Europe**: Port of Rotterdam (RTM), Hamburg (HAM), Antwerp, Frankfurt (FRA).
- **North America**: New York/New Jersey (NYC), Los Angeles/Long Beach (LAX), Chicago.

## Key Service Commitments
- **18-Minute Guaranteed Quotation**: Commercial rate desk issues verified all-inclusive quotes within 18 minutes.
- **Zero Hidden Demurrage**: Transparent port tariffs with predictable detention management.
- **Named Single-Point Director**: Every enterprise account is assigned a dedicated human logistics specialist.
